title: Why Do Cognitive Scientists Hate LLMs? (2023)
summary: This article explores the tension between cognitive scientists and large language models (LLMs), arguing that the criticism stems from fundamental differences in how human cognition and LLMs operate, and that understanding these differences is crucial for advancing AI.
highlights: Cognitive scientists often criticize LLMs for lacking true understanding, grounding, and causal reasoning.
The article suggests that LLMs are statistical pattern matchers, not cognitive models, and this distinction is key to the debate.
It argues that the hate is partly due to LLMs' success challenging traditional theories of cognition.
The piece calls for interdisciplinary collaboration to bridge the gap between AI and cognitive science.

title: GPU Management: Why Idle GPUs Are the New Grounded Aircraft
